Title: Azure Analysis Services diagnostic logging improvements for scale-out

Body.Content:
Get targeted log analysis with improvements to the Diagnostic Logs extension of Azure Analysis Services. Diagnostic Logs now allow you to access and break out server metrics like QPU and memory consumed for each query replica with the scale-out feature.

Diagnostic logging for Azure Analysis Services includes auditing, monitoring of server health, and detection of long-running queries and other scenarios. Event data is available for analysis in multiple repositories including Azure Monitor, and can be queried using the Kusto language.

Learn more about diagnostic logging and get sample Kusto queries >
